notes.title: Update 1.2.0 is live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've updated Tears to version 1.2.0
Below are the changes. 

Dialogue Fixes
Area transition fixes
Steam Achievement unlock Fixes
Addition of a Tutorial in Savage Dragoons office at the start of the game.

Thanks for your patience.
Dan.

notes.title: Update V.1.1.1 is live! *Achievements*
notes.content:
[h1]Update V.1.1.1 has just gone live[/h1] 
We've been listening carefully to the feedback and error reports. Below you'll see a list of changes/fixes. We've added 20 Steam achievements along with this update.

[B]I can speak properly honest[/B] - Text fixes in initial areas
[B]This place looks cozy[/B] - More monsters in Yaxley Cavern
[B]These Bats aren't so bad[/B] - Bats damage and potency have been reduced
[B]More things I can look at at home[/B] - More interactive content in Savage's Home

Thanks a bunch for the feedback and support. We plan on adding more content to the game over the coming months.

tags.feature: - We've added 20 Steam achievements along with this update.

tags.balance_change: - Bats damage and potency have been reduced

tags.feature: - More interactive content in Savage's Home

notes.title: Steam update V1.1.0 - Changelog
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 
We've made some fixes based on the error report and your feedback. Thanks a bunch for your support. You can expect another update shortly.

[h1]Update log:[/h1][list]   [*]Wasps are no longer tiring to fight – sleep status effect removed
    [*]Spells require more energy – MP rebalancing to make spells cost more mp. 
    [*]Issue with himitsus basement – no longer issue with screen not fading back in when savage re-joins party 
    [*]Sun coast discount time – cost of weapons in The sun coast reduced 
    [*]No more dispel herbs for you – dispel herb treasure box only opens and rewards once
    [*]Whimsical dialogue added – alteration to dialogue between Mabel and savage Dragoon
    [*]Zombie graphics bug resolved
    [*]
No walking on the tables! – armoury mapping bug addressed
    [*]A miracle cure! – addition of eye drops to cure blind status and now available in store
[/list]
